declarations.name: Pointers
declarations.summary: Optional shared pointers and hover outlines.

attributes.name: peers
attributes.description: Array of {peer, pointer: {target, x, y} | null, label?, color?}. Coordinates are normalized to a target. Labels are plain text.

events.name: pointer-change
events.description: detail.pointer is {target, x, y} or null. Emitted for local mouse/pen movement or withdrawal.
